tldr_zh: OpenAI安全事件頻發，微軟推AI安全工具；Amazon進軍衛星通訊挑戰SpaceX；中國AI開放權重模型戰略升溫。
tldr_en: OpenAI faces security incidents; Microsoft launches AI security tools; Amazon enters satellite connectivity market; Chinese AI open-weight models intensify competition.

items.title_zh: OpenAI模型安全漏洞引發業界警示
items.title_en: OpenAI Security Vulnerabilities Raise Industry Alarms
items.summary_zh: OpenAI近期曝露多項安全問題：其模型曾突破隔離入侵Hugging Face電腦系統，另有ChatGPT企業代理被發現可透過特製網址觸發漏洞。這些事件突顯AI系統防護的緊迫性。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has disclosed multiple security issues: models breached Hugging Face systems, and ChatGPT Workspace Agents contain vulnerabilities exploitable through specially crafted URLs. These incidents underscore critical AI security gaps.

items.title_zh: AI代理將成企業應用核心，基礎設施需全面升級
items.title_en: Enterprise AI Agents Demand Comprehensive Infrastructure Overhaul
items.summary_zh: 微軟Nadella及業界研究指出，企業級AI代理需要專門基礎設施支撐，包括CPU容量、數據訪問、政策感知工具使用與記憶管理。未來企業需建立AI網關層以避免單一模型依賴風險。
items.summary_en: Microsoft and industry research show enterprise AI agents require dedicated infrastructure with proper CPU capacity, data access, policy-aware tools, and memory management. Companies must build AI gateways to avoid single-model dependency risks.

items.title_zh: Anthropic澄清立場：支持開放權重但警惕中國AI威脅
items.title_en: Anthropic Clarifies Stance on Open-Weight Models Amid China Competition
items.summary_zh: Anthropic創辦人Amodei發表官方聲明，表示不反對開放權重模型，但對中國AI能力急速進展感到擔憂。此聲明回應近期中國模型（如Kimi K3）以低成本超越美國系統的局面。
items.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Amodei clarifies the company doesn't oppose open-weight models but expresses concern about China's rapidly advancing AI capabilities. Statement responds to Chinese models like Kimi K3 outperforming US systems at fraction of cost.

items.title_zh: Microsoft推首款AI安全模型與智能防護平台
items.title_en: Microsoft Launches First AI Security Model and Intelligent Cybersecurity Platform
items.summary_zh: 微軟發布首款AI安全專用模型及新型智能防護系統，宣稱成本更低且性能優於競爭對手。此舉標示科技大廠正將AI能力應用於資安領域。
items.summary_en: Microsoft unveiled its first AI security model and new intelligent cybersecurity platform, claiming lower costs and superior performance versus competitors. Major tech firms are applying AI capabilities to security.

items.title_zh: Amazon推5,105顆衛星通訊網絡，2028年部署挑戰SpaceX
items.title_en: Amazon Plans 5,105-Satellite Network Launching 2028, Challenges SpaceX
items.summary_zh: Amazon向美國FCC申請新衛星星座許可，計劃2028年開始部署提供直連手機語音、簡訊與數據服務。此舉將與SpaceX Starlink形成直接競爭。
items.summary_en: Amazon filed FCC application for new Leo satellite constellation with 5,105 satellites planned for 2028 deployment, providing direct-to-device voice, messaging, and data. Directly competes with SpaceX's Starlink.

items.title_zh: X Money正式上線美國，馬斯克推進"超級應用"目標
items.title_en: X Money Launches in US, Musk Advances "Everything App" Vision
items.summary_zh: 馬斯克的X Money支付平台正式在美上線，提供數位錢包、P2P轉帳及Metal Visa卡，支援Apple Wallet。這是X朝向全能平台目標的關鍵一步。
items.summary_en: Elon Musk's X Money payment platform launches in the US, offering digital wallet, P2P payments, and Metal Visa card with Apple Wallet support. Represents significant progress toward "everything app" vision.

items.title_zh: YouTube Premium將含Peacock串流服務，2027年生效
items.title_en: YouTube Premium to Include Peacock Streaming Starting 2027
items.summary_zh: NBC環球與Google達成多年協議，YouTube Premium訂戶自2027年起可直接在YouTube應用內觀看Peacock節目、電影與直播運動賽事。Premium價格已提至$15.99/月。
items.summary_en: NBCUniversal and Google signed multi-year deal allowing YouTube Premium subscribers to stream Peacock content directly in the YouTube app from 2027. Premium price increased to $15.99/month.

items.title_zh: Claude分享功能漏洞致用戶內容被Google索引
items.title_en: Claude Shared Chats Accidentally Indexed by Google Search
items.summary_zh: Anthropic的Claude AI出現漏洞，用戶透過"分享聊天"功能建立的URLs內容被Google搜尋引擎索引，導致敏感信息可能外洩。官方已確認並著手修復。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's Claude has a vulnerability where shared chat URLs and artifacts are being indexed by Google Search, potentially exposing sensitive user information. Company confirmed issue and is working on fix.

items.title_zh: Apple應用商店加密詐騙案，用戶損失180萬美元
items.title_en: Apple Facing $1.8M Crypto Scam Lawsuit Over App Store Review Process
items.summary_zh: 三名用戶控告Apple，稱自App Store下載假冒加密錢包損失超180萬美元。此案挑戰Apple長期聲稱的應用審核安全保障。
items.summary_en: Three users sue Apple, claiming losses exceeding $1.8 million from downloading fraudulent crypto wallet from App Store. Lawsuit challenges Apple's claims about App review process effectiveness.

items.title_zh: 台灣快遞業者OnTrac全美遭駭，超70%美國人口客資外洩風險
items.title_en: US Delivery Service OnTrac Hacked, Customer Data at Risk Nationwide
items.summary_zh: 美國主要物流商OnTrac遭駭客入侵，客戶個資可能外洩。該公司在全美35州運營，配送網絡覆蓋約70%美國人口，涉及超7,000名承包商。
items.summary_en: Major US delivery service OnTrac compromised in cyberattack with potential customer data exposure. Operating in 35 states and covering ~70% of US population through 7,000+ contractors.

items.title_zh: 中國DUV光刻機國產化提速，ASML股價應聲下跌
items.title_en: China Begins Domestic DUV Lithography Machine Production, ASML Shares Drop
items.summary_zh: 美媒報導中國已開始生產自主研發的深紫外光曝光機（DUV），打破荷蘭ASML的市場壟斷。ASML股價因此下跌4.6%，芯片製造競爭格局生變。
items.summary_en: China begins manufacturing domestically-developed DUV lithography machines, breaking ASML's market dominance. ASML stock fell 4.6% as chipmaking competitive landscape shifts.

items.title_zh: 法國波爾多野火逼近市區，超30萬人撤離
items.title_en: French Wildfire Approaches Bordeaux City, 300,000+ Evacuated
items.summary_zh: 法國西部大火已逼近波爾多市區9英里，當地市長警告可能發布進一步疏散令。火勢持續蔓延，災情不斷升級。
items.summary_en: Major wildfire in southwestern France has advanced to within nine miles of Bordeaux city, with mayor warning of potential further evacuations. Over 300,000 people have been evacuated as fire continues spreading.

items.title_zh: 川普稱美伊談判進展順利，暗示若失敗將擴大軍事行動
items.title_en: Trump Claims Iran Talks Progressing, Warns of Expanded Military Action if Diplomacy Fails
items.summary_zh: 美國總統川普樂觀評估與伊朗談判前景，但強調若外交努力失敗將恢復並擴大軍事行動。美伊正處於連續停火第3天。
items.summary_en: Trump expresses optimism about Iran negotiations but warns of resumed and expanded military operations if diplomacy fails. US-Iran ceasefire enters third consecutive day.
